slides.headline: ELON MUSK WILL NOW SHAPE THE FUTURE OF WAR

caption:
Elon Musk is now officially advising the Pentagon on the future of war.

Elon Musk, a man who has never served a single day in uniform, will now sit across from US generals and tell them how America's next wars should be fought. He owns SpaceX and Starlink, the rockets and satellite networks that armies around the world already use in active combat. He is now also the one advising on how those same armies should fight next. The guy who profits most from how wars are fought is now the one writing the playbook for the US military.

Tech billionaires have been creeping into national security for years. Now it's formal. Your defense strategy is being shaped by the same person whose rockets and satellites already run it. That line is gone.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this kind of shift means for yours.

Sources: Washington Post

#ElonMusk #Pentagon #AI #NationalSecurity #Technology
pinned_comment: Would you want the person who already owns the rockets and satellites your military runs on to also decide how your next war gets fought? Because that just happened.

editor_override: COVER IMAGE FAILS PROOF/ARCHETYPE TEST: The image is a neutral close-up headshot of Musk in a Tesla sweatshirt against a plain white background. The thumb test fails — at feed size, a stranger sees Musk's face but cannot guess this story has anything to do with war, the Pentagon, or a military advisory role. IMAGE LAW requires the cover to answer 'what would prove this headline in half a second.'
gate_r: s1: The photo is a low-quality candid close-up with the top of Musk's head visibly amputated at the frame edge — it lacks the bright, saturated press-photo energy the standard requires.
